text:
sara_support: Heads-up — ACME (tenant acme-inc) opened an escalation: sudden p95/p99 spike on /v1/generate starting ~02:05 UTC. p95 ~220ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~380ms -> 3.1s. Only affects the redwood-std-small model route. No auth/billing errors in logs.

mike_sre: thx Sara. Do we have request rate/size profile? small prompts or large? any change in traffic pattern?

sara_support: Mostly small prompts (avg tokens ~12). Rate steady ~120 qps for that tenant. We attached a sample curl they used to repro. No recent deploy on their side.

raj_eng: small prompts + continuous batching = classic hold-time tail. Can you paste a sample of the batcher logs around the spike window? Looking for long hold before batch flush or singletons being held.

sara_support: pasted logs (excerpt):
```
[02:04:58.112] batcher DEBUG tenant=acme treq_id=abc123 enqueue -> hold=0ms
[02:05:01.423] batcher DEBUG tenant=acme assembled batch size=1 hold_ms=310
[02:05:01.424] rt DEBUG model=redwood-std-small start_infer
[02:05:03.515] rt INFO model=redwood-std-small infer_duration_ms=2091 tokens=14
```
Noticed a lot of singletons held ~250-400ms before flush.

mike_sre: that aligns. Recent platform config change pushed default `coalesce_timeout_ms` to 300 for headrooms last week; might be the culprit for low-volume tenants. ACME's QPS is modest so they hit long hold times.

olivia_platform: I flagged that change in last Friday's rollout notes but forgot tenant-level overrides. Quick mitigation: lower their coalesce timeout and enable adaptive_fallback so single requests short-circuit to non-coalesced path. Proposed tenant override: 
```
continuous_batcher:
  coalesce_timeout_ms: 8
  max_batch_size: 16
  adaptive_fallback: true
```
This should reduce p95/p99 for small prompts.

raj_eng: agreed. Additional longer-term: make default adaptive by qps threshold so low-throughput tenants don't get 300ms holds. For now, can someone run the tenant patch?

sara_support: running quick patch now: `platformctl patch-tenant acme-inc --set continuous_batcher.coalesce_timeout_ms=8 --set continuous_batcher.adaptive_fallback=true`

deploy-bot: patch-tenant(acme-inc) started by sara_support at 1701112305

deploy-bot: patch-tenant(acme-inc) succeeded at 1701112332 :white_check_mark:

mike_sre: can you check p95/p99 in monitoring? give it a few mins to warm.

sara_support: initial telemetry after patch: p95 back to ~180ms, p99 ~260ms. We'll keep monitoring and ask ACME to confirm.

olivia_platform: filing follow-up to revert global default and rollout adaptive-by-qps change. Creating RFC for safer defaults and tenant override docs.

raj_eng: also add an alert runbook note: "if small-prompt tenant p99 spikes and logs show assembled batch size=1 with hold_ms>100 => patch coalesce_timeout_ms to <=10 or enable adaptive_fallback"

sara_support: ACME confirmed improvement over DM. I'll close the escalation once stable for 1h. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike_sre: nice quick mitigation. Marking for postmortem if it recurs.

olivia_platform: :eyes: opening follow-up ticket -> PLAT-4821 for default change + docs."
